A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FAHNES and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–J. Content can be matched across terminology changes and pagination shifts without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original FAHNES evaluations on graphs, hypergraphs, meshes, and point clouds, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, and generated samples in Section 5 and Appendices I–J.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical evaluations, ablations, and generated samples in Section 5 and Appendices I–J.

M1.justification: The stated procedures receive functional corrections: Algorithm 5 replaces the self-referential node-count calculation with an explicit bounded update and reverses the expansion-selection inequality to select the highest scores. Algorithm 3 revises small-graph spectral truncation. The architecture, objectives, and overall generation framework remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same five unfeatured hypergraph datasets, five unfeatured graph datasets, and airplane/bench mesh and featured point-cloud tasks. ManifoldNet becoming Manifold40 corrects terminology; the underlying datasets and categories are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding main-text and appendix tables, including HYGENE, HyperPA, HSpectre, BwR, DiGress, DeFoG, and the mesh baselines. Flow Matching becoming Flow-Matching is only a naming edit.

E3.justification: Appendices E.2 and E.4 change the stated ChamDist reference set from validation/test samples to training samples, aligning with the existing Section 5.1 definition. Appendix C changes the stated rejection probability from 1−λ to λ, matching the retained Algorithm 1 condition. These are reported protocol corrections; reruns are not established.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Tables 5, 10, and 11, alternative coarsening strategies in Table 12, and sample comparisons are retained. Figure 3 redisplays existing Appendix J examples; it adds no new ablation, robustness test, or case-study evidence.

E5.justification: Appendix I in both versions defines reported values as means plus or minus twice the standard deviation over five runs. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–12 and the generated example images are retained. Figure 3’s new caption explicitly reports skeleton-like airplane point clouds and missing fine detail in airplane and bench outputs, adding qualitative findings without demonstrating improved performance.

T1.justification: Appendix B.2 revises the OT marginal-preservation proof, explicitly separating source invariance on graph space from the unchanged target marginal. Appendix H revises complexity bounds to include hidden polylogarithmic factors and adds a graph-specific bound requiring at most O(k) triangles. The principal propositions remain.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about scalable hierarchical joint topology/feature generation, local growth control, and multi-scale OT coupling. Renaming hierarchical scale encoding to node budget does not introduce a new contribution.

C2.justification: Figure 3 newly interprets deficient point-cloud outputs as resembling intermediate-scale representations rather than fully refined samples. Appendix H adds an explicit applicability condition for graph scalability through its triangle-count assumption. Existing limitations concerning size, feature types, and training cost remain.

D1.justification: Algorithm 2 now explicitly handles three-node permutations already described in v3’s prose. Appendix E clarifies random positional encodings and when SignNet encodings are bypassed, while the algorithms correct initialization and indexing details. Hardware, training budgets, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The bibliography and substantive positioning relative to flat and hierarchical generators remain unchanged. Additional placements of existing Bergmeister et al. citations reinforce attribution already present in v3.

P1.justification: v4 replaces hierarchical scale encoding with node budget, standardizes dataset terminology, and tightens sentences throughout the abstract, introduction, method explanations, and appendices. The section sequence and overall narrative organization are retained.

P2.justification: New main-text Figure 3 rearranges mesh and point-cloud panels already present in Appendix J, where they remain. The coarsening figure becomes Figure 4, captions and table labels change, and appendix algorithm placement and whitespace are adjusted.

improvement.justification: v4 improves reproducibility and precision through corrected algorithm specifications, more consistent ChamDist documentation, and better-qualified complexity reasoning. The accessible sample figure and explicit discussion of geometric shortcomings improve transparency. These are useful but limited gains: the numerical evidence is retained, and the PDFs do not establish new empirical validation of the revised specifications.
